parameters: \c[1]Embor Palace, throne room of Duke Jaromir\c[0]
Ah... we finally meet.\! The Duchy of Embor is restored, thanks to...
\n[8].\! I take it you are Duke Jaromir?
What the...\| Guess I look the part, huh?
Donar stands before me.\! How can I not kneel before you?!\! You are here, more than just a myth or a legend...\! This is the foremost moment in my life...
Alright, alright, let's just be people here...
You have come to our world to destroy evil.\! There is no other possibility... please, allow me to join the ranks of your army, holy Donar...
I don't have much of an army yet.\! But I know there are many people out there just like you, waiting for the opportunity to strike back.
It's quite a risk, the Empire's going to want your hide...
My lands, my resources, and my own blade are at your disposal, holy Donar.\! My soldiers are the most resolute in all of Veridia.\! Please, give us our divine mission at once!
Please don't bow to me.\! We're not the Empire, we're the free people of Veridia.\! Let's see what the famed warriors of Embor can do on the battlefield!
